Apartament 1+1 per shitje ne Astir
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje objekt te ri me ashensor dhe administrim shume te mire ne Astir shume prane me unazen e madhe.
Apartamenti eshte i organizuar nga nje koridor/tualet/dhome gjumi/sallon bashke me ambjentin e gatimit dhe nje ballkon.!
Apartamenti ka hapsira te bolleshme dhe planimetri shume funksionale.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 6 me orientim jugperndim.
Apartamenti eshte totalisht i investuar nga e para me rifinituara moderne dhe cilesore.!
Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
( nuk shitet me kredi)
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Astir The apartment is located in a new building with elevator and very good administration in Astir, very close to the big ring. The apartment is organized by a corridor/toilet/bedroom/living room together with the cooking area and a balcony. The apartment has spacious spaces and a very functional layout. The apartment is located on the 6th floor with southwest orientation. The apartment is completely invested from scratch with modern and quality refinishing. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation. (not sold on credit)
